description: FastAPI router module for managing recipes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting recipes with associated tags and user authentication.

methods.name: _get_or_create_tags
methods.description: Retrieve existing tags or create new ones based on provided tag names.

methods.name: _recipe_to_response
methods.description: Convert a Recipe ORM object to a RecipeResponse schema, including safe handling of timestamps and tags.

methods.name: list_recipes
methods.description: List or search recipes with optional text query and tag filter.

methods.name: get_recipe
methods.description: Retrieve a single recipe by ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: create_recipe
methods.description: Create a new recipe authored by the current user, with optional tags.

methods.name: update_recipe
methods.description: Update an existing recipe if the user is the author, including tags.

methods.name: delete_recipe
methods.description: Delete a recipe if the user is the author.
